pages.text: Functions get copies of their parameters. A function that changes a text, list or hash gives back the changed copy as $(1)result$().$(br2)To change a variable, use it both as parameter and as result target:
$(1)CALL INSERT$(br)  PARAMETER array list ;$(br)  PARAMETER index 0 ;$(br)  PARAMETER value 0 ;$(br)  RESULT result list$()
